intro_html: All the good parts of a banh mi, the tangy pickled vegetables, the sriracha mayo, the savory meat, moved off the baguette and onto rice. Each bowl brings 29 grams of protein for about $3.38, and nothing goes soggy in the fridge.
cost_closing_html: About $3.38 a bowl for banh mi bowls with pickled veg and sriracha mayo. Sandwich shops charge $13 for a banh mi-inspired bowl half this size. The mayo alone is doing premium work here.
shop_smart: Ground turkey handles the protein at about $12.71 for 3.5 pounds, cheaper than the grilled pork a banh mi shop would use and it soaks up the lemongrass and fish sauce just as well.
Cucumbers and carrots are your volume for about $6 combined. Quick-pickling them in vinegar and sugar makes cheap produce taste like a specialty condiment.
Sriracha and rice vinegar are one-bottle buys. This batch uses maybe $1.50 of each, and both keep practically forever in the pantry.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook the rice per the package and set it aside.
Quick-pickle the vegetables: shred the carrots and slice a third of the cucumbers thin, then toss with the rice vinegar and sugar. Let them sit at least 20 minutes, stirring once or twice.
Make the sriracha mayo: stir about two thirds of the sriracha into the mayonnaise with half the lime juice.

Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over high heat. Brown the ground turkey, breaking it up, then add the garlic, lemongrass paste, and remaining sriracha, and cook until the turkey reaches 165F.
Stir the fish sauce and remaining lime juice into the turkey and let it sizzle 1 more minute.
Build bowls: rice, lemongrass turkey, pickled veg, fresh cucumber, green onions, and a drizzle of sriracha mayo. Pack extra mayo separately if you like it cold.
portion_html: Weigh the rice and turkey together, subtract the empty pot weight you wrote down, and divide by 14, then split the pickles, cucumber, and mayo evenly. Each bowl lands at about 674 calories with 29 grams of protein.

head.description: Turkey banh mi bowl meal prep: 14 bowls, 674 calories and 29g protein each, about $3.38 a serving. Lemongrass turkey, pickled veg, and sriracha mayo.
head.keywords: banh mi bowl, turkey banh mi, vietnamese meal prep, sriracha mayo, pickled vegetables, ground turkey recipe
steps: Cook the rice and quick-pickle shredded carrots and sliced cucumber in vinegar and sugar.
Stir sriracha and lime into the mayonnaise.
Brown ground turkey with garlic, lemongrass paste, and sriracha to 165F.
Finish the turkey with fish sauce and lime juice.
Assemble bowls with rice, turkey, pickles, fresh cucumber, and sriracha mayo, then portion into 14 containers.
